**Describe the Bug**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

**Component Affected**
- [ ] In-Game Prices / SFL Exchange Rate
- [ ] OpenSea Floor Listings / Verification
- [ ] Price Diff (Arbitrage) Calculations
- [ ] Search & Filters
- [ ] UI / Display (Grid vs Table View)
- [ ] Data Updater Script / GitHub Action

**Item Name & ID (if applicable)**
- Item Name: e.g. `Gnome`
- Token ID: e.g. `603`

**Expected Behavior**
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

**Screenshots / Logs**
If applicable, add screenshots or console output to help explain your problem.

**Desktop / Device Information:**
 - OS: [e.g. Windows, macOS, iOS, Android]
 - Browser: [e.g. Chrome, Safari, Firefox]
 - Version: [e.g. 120]
